# SkyLap Laptop Service Centre

> Laptop repair workshop in Whitefield, Bengaluru. Chip-level (component-level) motherboard repair, screen, battery, keyboard, hinge, charging port, cooling, SSD and RAM upgrades, data recovery and Windows repair, plus spares and upgrades. One workshop only; pickup areas are not branches. Independent repair centre, not affiliated with any laptop manufacturer.

- Address: First Floor, 6/1, Whitefield Main Road, opposite Dress Circle Mall, Whitefield, Bengaluru 560066 (first floor; another shop is at street level)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 96061 20007
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 10am–8pm; Sunday, call first
- Free diagnosis and one written quote before any work starts
- Free pickup and drop: Whitefield, ITPL, EPIP Zone, Brookefield, Kadugodi, Hoodi, Varthur. Rest of Bengaluru by arranged courier.
- Payment: UPI, bank transfer, cash

## Repairs
- [All repairs](https://skylap.in/services): every repair done at the Whitefield bench
- [Chip-level motherboard repair](https://skylap.in/services/chip-level-motherboard-repair): no power, no display, liquid or surge damage, charging IC, shorts
- [Screen replacement](https://skylap.in/services/laptop-screen-replacement): cracked, black, flickering or lined screens
- [Battery replacement](https://skylap.in/services/laptop-battery-replacement): draining, swollen or not charging
- [Charging port repair](https://skylap.in/services/laptop-charging-port-repair): charges only at an angle or not at all
- [Keyboard and trackpad](https://skylap.in/services/laptop-keyboard-replacement): dead keys, auto typing, trackpad faults
- [Hinge and body](https://skylap.in/services/laptop-hinge-repair): broken hinges, loose lid, cracked case
- [Cooling and overheating](https://skylap.in/services/laptop-overheating-repair): cleaning, thermal paste, fans
- [SSD and RAM upgrade](https://skylap.in/services/laptop-ssd-ram-upgrade): speed up a slow laptop, data cloned across
- [Data recovery](https://skylap.in/services/data-recovery-whitefield): files from dead laptops and failed disks
- [Gaming laptop repair](https://skylap.in/services/gaming-laptop-repair): throttling, GPU not detected, high-refresh screens
- [Software and Windows](https://skylap.in/services/laptop-virus-removal): boot loops, blue screens, corrupted OS
- Brands: [HP](https://skylap.in/services/hp-laptop-service-center-whitefield), [Dell](https://skylap.in/services/dell-laptop-service-center-whitefield), [Lenovo](https://skylap.in/services/lenovo-laptop-service-center-whitefield), [ASUS](https://skylap.in/services/asus-laptop-service-center-whitefield), [Acer](https://skylap.in/services/acer-laptop-service-center-whitefield)
